topic_keywords: trajectory, obstacle, members, upper members, robot adapted, collision, safety zone, avoidance obstacle
representative_doc: The invention relates to a humanoid robot which can move on its lower limb to execute a trajectory. According to the invention, the robot is capable of detecting intrusion of obstacles in a safety zone defined around its body as a function of its speed.
rationale: Explicitly describes obstacle detection in a safety zone and collision avoidance for a humanoid robot.

topic_keywords: impedance, force control, contact force, compliance control, foot end, humanoid robot
representative_doc: The invention monitors the contact force vector and sliding trend in real time through multi-dimensional tactile sensors. A three-level tactile response layer is used to dynamically switch the force/position mixed impedance mode.
rationale: Monitors contact force and switches impedance mode to ensure safe human-robot physical interaction.

topic_keywords: elements, skin, flexible, humanoid type, outer surface, contact, movement given range
representative_doc: The invention relates to the safety of use of a humanoid-type robot. The two elements each comprising a skin delimiting the outer surface thereof, the articulation allowing movement in a given range, a first element being intended to come substantially into contact with a region of the skin of a second element.
rationale: Flexible skin and controlled contact range are designed to prevent injury during humanoid robot motion.

topic_keywords: elements, abutment, articulation, switch, contact, force exerted, exceeds given force
representative_doc: A humanoid-type robot comprises two elements and an articulation. The switch is configured to actuate an electrical contact when a force exerted by the first element against the abutment exceeds a given force.
rationale: Force-threshold switch stops excessive force at a joint, directly protecting humans and hardware.

topic_keywords: disaster, emergency, safety control, braking, stop, torque control, humanoid robot
representative_doc: The invention provides an emergency shutdown control method of a wheeled humanoid robot in an industrial scene. When receiving the emergency stop signal, collect state information and determine emergency braking parameters.
rationale: Emergency shutdown and braking control for humanoid robot in industrial scene.

topic_keywords: emergency stop, emergency, stop control, stop switch, protection button, quadruped robot
representative_doc: The utility model discloses a multi-mode emergency stop mechanism of a quadruped robot. The robot is provided with three emergency stop modes: a line emergency stop switch, a power supply emergency stop switch and an instruction emergency stop switch.
rationale: Multi-mode emergency stop mechanism explicitly for robot safety.

topic_keywords: image, monitoring, human face, security, camera, face recognition, safety helmet
representative_doc: The invention discloses a method for rapidly calculating identity characteristics of privacy security. Multi-channel monitoring cameras collect videos and each AI analysis box processes real-time image frames.
rationale: Surveillance/identity recognition for privacy security, not a humanoid robot safety mechanism that protects humans from robot hazards.

topic_keywords: planning, virtual, ar vr, risk value, hand device, interactive terminal
representative_doc: A humanoid robot based on AR/VR. The hybrid interactive terminal recognizes user instructions to control the robot body, and at the same time provides somatosensory feedback to the user.
rationale: AR/VR human-robot interaction and planning; risk value is mentioned but not as an explicit safety control mechanism.

topic_keywords: elevator, human shaped, real humanoid, construction elevator, identification, video image
representative_doc: The invention provides an elevator lifting intelligent identification system. The acquisition module receives an elevator starting signal and acquires a video image in an elevator car.
rationale: Elevator passenger identification for safety monitoring, not a humanoid robot mechanism.

topic_keywords: member, movable, element, compact actuator, force control, device
representative_doc: The utility model discloses a compact actuator device, comprising a motor, a reducer and a transmission mechanism. The device has the advantages of compact structure and large output torque.
rationale: Generic actuator hardware; no explicit humanoid robot safety or human-protection purpose.
